_doc: The FM-1 knob that the SLOOP backend offers as an encoder (control input "knob") for generative mode. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_param: The track parameter (its label on the device) used as the knob: PHS is LFO > PHS, silent while the LFO's destinations are 0. The firmware reports knob turns only for the selected track: select the armed track on the FM-1.
_center: Where the knob is parked while in use (room to turn both ways), and again after it has been still far from it; its original value comes back afterwards.
